_doc: L3 corpus table (xarm_l3.py). root: read-only checkout, never built or run. scope: directories whose C/C++ files are tokenized (the translation units); the census and the prism runs see every C-like file of the corpus. flags: clang flags, {CONFIG} is the corpus's config directory (under the L3 output, never inside the corpus). config: files placed there (name -> {from, note}); `from` is a host path, its sha256 is recorded in the sweep summary.

pyconfig.h.note: configure-generated pyconfig.h of an installed macOS aarch64 CPython 3.14.4 (the corpus is 3.16-dev: macros added since are undefined). The checkout's only pyconfig.h is the Windows one (PC/pyconfig.h) and the host has none from configure.

protobuf.late_note: installed Homebrew abseil (outside the corpus, read only, searched after every in-repo directory): the corpus names absl headers it does not hold; with them stubbed empty, `ABSL_HAVE_BUILTIN(x)` in an #if makes 309 of 319 protobuf files fatal
